package rulefixtures

import (
	"context"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"testing"
)

// scenario for repository_tests_depend_on_http_transport_types: Repository tests that assert HTTP DTOs or handler-layer types.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: info.
type Rule137PositiveRepo struct {
	db interface{}
}

func TestScenario137Positive(t *testing.T) {
	repo := &Rule137PositiveRepo{}
	req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, "/users", nil)
	req.Header.Set("X-Tenant", "acme")

	ctx := context.WithValue(req.Context(), "request", req)
	_ = repo.db
	_ = ctx
}
